question: Instituted in 1984, the National-level Lata Mangeshkar Award is given to promote excellence in the area of light music annually by the ____________ government's culture department.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National-level Lata Mangeshkar Award was instituted in **1984**.
 
• This award is given annually by the **Madhya Pradesh** government's culture department.
 
• The award aims to promote excellence in the area of **light music**.
 
• It is one of the prestigious awards in the field of music in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** is a legendary playback singer in India, known for her melodious voice and contribution to Indian music.
 
• The award named after her celebrates her legacy and encourages artists in the field of light music.
 
• Recipients of this award are celebrated for their outstanding contribution to music and are recognized at a national level.
 
• The award includes a cash prize, a citation, and a shawl.
